programme.title: PL Stories 2026/27 - EP16

The hosts have a strong recent record against the West Indies this decade having won eight of the last nine ODI's since 2020. The last time these two sides met in this format was in a three-match contest in 2023 that India won 2-1. The last game of that series saw the hosts win by a massive 200 runs after bowling the West Indies out for just 151 in their pursuit of 352.
